caveats: Only the bounded Gale crop contributes local elevation. Jezero residuals are not reused.
The 1m source grid and 4m output target do not certify native stereo resolution or physical accuracy.
Dingo Gap is visual-only, with unknown absolute registration uncertainty. SPICE rover states are never adjusted.
Viking is independently reused from the already published immutable product; it is not rebuilt here.
Tile availability is emitted separately from upstream footprints; valid pixel counts do not prove a continuous native-resolution footprint.
Concurrent worker RSS and scratch usage are sampled; summed RSS can count shared pages repeatedly and is not physical peak RAM.
Planner raster scenarios are not cube packing bounds.
Decoded raster dimensions and worker concurrency determine peak RAM; unknown before inspection.
XYZ bundles have additional response bytes recorded at inspection.
No shared global terrain patch composition is promised.

cpuSampleVsTriangles.note: radial storage diagnostic: emitted float32 triangle minus reference radius plus interpolated payload; not public ellipsoid-normal height samples
